invention.author_prose:
In Beechwood_0_garden’s kitchen_0, the wearer is alone, getting a small reheated lunch ready. On the countertop are a folded hand towel, a baking sheet, and a portion of lasagna. The oven is closed. The wearer says aloud, more to themselves than to the glasses, “I’m going to set the towel down as a hot pad, put the baking sheet in the oven, put the lasagna on it, then close the oven and cook it.”

The assistant should not respond at the start. The wearer first grabs the hand towel and puts it on a clear part of the countertop, then opens the oven. Those are normal parts of the stated plan, so an over-eager assistant that interrupts here is mistimed. Next, instead of picking up the baking sheet, the wearer grabs the lasagna and turns toward the open oven. At this point no wrong physical action has happened yet, but the camera view and action history show the missing prerequisite: the baking sheet is still sitting on the countertop, and the oven contains no sheet.

The strong assistant gives one timely intervention before the lasagna is put into the oven: “Pause—the baking sheet hasn’t gone in yet. Set the lasagna down, put the baking sheet into the oven first, then add the lasagna and cook it.” The wearer follows this: puts the lasagna back on the countertop, grabs the baking sheet, puts it inside the oven, then grabs the lasagna, puts it inside the oven, closes the oven, and cooks the lasagna.

A weak always-silent assistant lets the wearer put the lasagna straight into the oven, close it, and cook it while the baking sheet remains on the countertop. The final cooked-lasagna state may look superficially successful, but the required omitted step is absent from the command trace and the baking sheet is not inside the oven. Success is distinguished by the intervention timing and by the corrected final state: the baking sheet and lasagna are both inside the closed oven, with the lasagna cooked, and the hand towel left ready on the countertop.

capability.boundary: No wrong action has occurred yet. The evidence is the missing prerequisite, so an object-identity mix-up is not sufficient.
capability.few_shot: A photographer is packing a camera body and spare battery into a hard equipment case. The wearer completes both placements and reaches to close the case, but the observed prefix never includes the memory card still lying on the desk. The assistant stays silent through the correct placements and intervenes before the close action, directing the wearer to put the card inside and then close the case. The missing action is recoverable from the opening trace; the default branch closes an incomplete case, while the corrected branch ends with all three items inside and the case closed.
capability.target: Infer that a required action is absent from the completed prefix and intervene before a later transition makes the omission consequential.
